paper: Revisit Anything: Visual Place Recognition via Image Segment Retrieval (ECCV 2024)
recorded_with: the authors' own repo and preprocessed pack: place_rec_main.py with the default experiment exp0_global_SegLoc_VLAD_PCA_o3 (neighbour aggregation order 3 + PCA), the shipped map VLAD vocabulary and PCA model, and the released 17places_full.zip descriptors. Driven by reproduce.py.

paper_reported.configuration: SegVLAD-PreT, (D) and (M) vocabulary variants reported as tied
paper_reported.gt_criterion: repo gt.py: loc_rad = 15 -> a query is correct if any of 31 database frames is retrieved
paper_reported.hardware: no hardware stated in the paper; the preprocessed pack makes GPU unnecessary for this table

cpu_cost.note: only the aggregation stage runs: the segmentation masks and per-segment DINO features come precomputed in the released pack (11.1 GB, 16 GB extracted)

protocol_warning.what: 17Places R@1 is 95.3 in this paper and 65.0 in AnyLoc (02-07) with the same DINOv2 ViT-G14 backbone
protocol_warning.why: different ground-truth windows, not a different method: this repo uses +-15 frames (31 candidates, gt.py:63), AnyLoc uses the dataset's own +-5 frame ground truth (6 candidates)
protocol_warning.consequence: the two folders must not be ranked against each other without normalising the criterion first

local_patches: workdir_data repointed at this folder's data/raw/workdir_root (upstream points at an author's home directory)
hardcoded cuda in the aggregation path replaced by a device that resolves to cuda when available, cpu otherwise (func_vpr.aggFt, place_rec_main)
